name: Tuning-Free Model-Size Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method to control the final number of 3D Gaussian primitives in a scene to a user-specified budget B, without per-scene hyperparameter tuning, by using a Lagrangian relaxation of the population constraint and a dual ascent controller.
summary: Tuning-Free Model-Size Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting guarantees an exact primitive count via a Lagrangian relaxation and dual ascent controller, eliminating per-scene hyperparameter tuning.
